triggers.detailsText: As per the Letter of Intent received from APTRANSCO, the order comprises the supply of 95 units of 50 MVA, 132/33 kV Power Transformers, aggregating 4,750 MVA of transformation capacity, including 50 units under Lot-1 and 45 units under Lot-2, with an aggregate contract value of approximately Rs 523.21 crore, net of GST. This order builds on Atlanta Electricals' existing engagement with APTRANSCO, following the Company's earlier order for the supply of transformers aggregating 3,120 MVA, valued at approximately Rs 270 crore, further strengthening its relationship with one of India's leading state transmission utilities. The addition of this order provides strong revenue visibility and reflecting the growing demand for transmission infrastructure investments across India.

The addition of this order provides strong revenue visibility and reflecting the growing demand for transmission infrastructure investments across India.
